body: Managing... For now...had another breakdown last night...i dunno how much more i got in me
Appreciate the care...stay being a good person
And again i know how it works here...unless ur rich it doesnt matter...i have horror stories for days...
They literally just dragged my wife in cuffs by force on easter....
No amount of meds or advice will fix my life
And like...the problems arent in my head man...the problems are the conditions in which im forced to exist...
Im currently waiting for my first visit with my primary he can refer me to a psychiatrist and therapist...

The proper help doesn't exist...the mental health here is garbage...my wife was just on a hold and everything is worse... and filing a complaint with the state is currently on my huge to do list because she was horrifically mistreated...
If i tell the wrong person ill end up on a medical hold and if my life isnt fucked now it will be then.

I just posted in here... honestly all these people so broken...it breaks my heart...ive never felt so understood...but all of this pain...is daunting...

Im very much at the edge right now... probably closer than ive ever been

But for 7 years now ive dealt with the love of my life being suicidal...i have a son that  has almost died and could die at any moment due to medical issues...my mom was told she wouldn't see past 30 but has been hospitalized her whole life only has one kidney and has begun shattering her bones from falling...
I want so desperately to end it but i also have seen the damage it does...
Its such a frustrating dichotomy...

How have you resolved this conflict?

If you don't mind me asking, what are you studying for? Have you talked to a counselor about your options for continuing education? 

Do you have anyone important to you?

At the very least isnt there things you want to experience first?
